scope: All public RadioPack France packs, with inland-navigation VHF treated separately from maritime VHF and lake-specific radio.

national_sources.title: Manuel CRR fluvial - version 6, mai 2025
findings: Voie 10 is the first boat-to-boat channel.
Channel 6 is prohibited for use on the Rhine between PK 150 and 350.
Inland navigation uses dedicated information-nautical and port-authority channels depending on location.

national_sources.title: Le réseau navigable
national_sources.finding: France has a large connected inland-waterway network; VNF manages 6,700 km of it.

packs.evidence: Seine/Basse-Seine navigation uses VHF, including channel 10 for boat-to-boat announcements; lower Seine also interfaces with Rouen/Seine maritime traffic.
packs.next_action: Verify the published Normandie marine block contains all Seine inland RF used by current RPP/VNF/HAROPA assignments; do not duplicate identical RF.

packs.evidence: Navigable canals and rivers exist, but this pass has not yet established a current official region-wide VHF assignment requiring extra RF beyond the existing marine block.
packs.next_action: Check current canal/Vilaine/Rance/Nantes-Brest operating documents; if a used inland channel is already in the marine block, record coverage without duplicating it.

packs.evidence: VNF Nord-Pas-de-Calais changed large-gauge lock VHF allocation from 2 to 5 channels effective 2026-07-28.
packs.next_action: Capture the five current lock/PCC channels from the VNF 2026 map and verify all RF are already present in the marine block.

packs.evidence: VHF watch on channel 10 is mandatory in Paris/Val-de-Marne under the current Seine-Yonne rules; VNF PCC locks also expose VHF call channels.
packs.next_action: Prepare Île-de-France v0.4 inland-VHF scope from current Seine/Marne/Oise lock and navigation assignments.

packs.evidence: CCNR 2026 documents active VHF assignments on the French Rhine and Moselle; ANFR documents the national inland boat-to-boat channels.
packs.next_action: Build Grand Est v0.4 with 13 deduplicated inland-VHF RX memories.

packs.evidence: VNF operates navigable canals including Briare/Loing and the canal latéral à la Loire, but current specific VHF assignments have not yet been proven in this pass.
packs.next_action: Review current RPP/VNF operating documents before adding any RF.

packs.evidence: VNF states professional vessels on the Loire must maintain constant VHF watch on channel 10; other users are advised to do the same.
packs.next_action: Verify channel 10 and any local Loire/estuary working channels are already represented; add provenance, not duplicate RF.

packs.evidence: VNF Saône guide assigns boat-to-boat channel 10, Lyon transition channel 18, safety multidiffusion channel 12 and lock channels 20/22.
packs.next_action: Prepare Bourgogne-Franche-Comté v0.4 with the current Saône inland VHF set, deduplicated by RF.

packs.evidence: VNF documents navigable Garonne access to Bordeaux and requires contact with the port on VHF channel 12 for entry into the Grand Port Maritime de Bordeaux.
packs.next_action: Audit Garonne/Canal des Deux Mers working channels and record existing RF coverage without duplication.

packs.evidence: VNF Rhône/Saône operating documents use VHF channel 10 for boat-to-boat and channels 19/20/22 for locks; Saône also uses channel 12 and 18 in defined sectors.
packs.next_action: Prepare Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes v0.3 inland-VHF scope for Rhône/Saône.

packs.evidence: VNF Rhône-Saône bulletins document VHF use on the Canal du Rhône à Sète, including channels 10 and 18.
packs.next_action: Audit Canal du Rhône à Sète and Canal du Midi assignments; avoid duplicate RF already in marine block.

packs.evidence: Lower Rhône/Barcarin/Port-Saint-Louis navigation uses inland VHF, including channel 10 and lock channels 19/20/22 depending on sector.
packs.next_action: Verify lower-Rhône inland assignments are all RF-covered by the marine block and document dual maritime/inland use.

packs.evidence: No significant VNF inland-navigation network requiring a separate fluvial VHF block was identified; the pack is already coastal/maritime.
packs.next_action: No fluvial addition; keep maritime scope only unless a specific inland-waterway source is identified.

packs.evidence: This territorial pack is dominated by lacustrine rather than fluvial navigation.
packs.next_action: Keep lake-specific radio review separate from the national fluvial-VHF rollout.
